now: Agatha's coven walks the Road, one trial at a time.
proposed: Billy and Jen rejoin Agatha at the end of the Road, which turns out to be a circle, and in Agatha's trial Jen unbinds her own magic.
changes.evidence: The entry sums up the whole journey. In episode 8 (Follow Me My Friend / To Glory at the End) Billy and Jen rejoin Agatha at the end of the Road, find it is a circle, and are taken to a version of Agatha's basement for her trial, where Jen performs an unbinding ritual and regains her abilities.

now: Danny and Davos grow up training side by side for the title of Iron Fist.
proposed: Lei Kung names Danny the winner of his duel with Davos for the right to become the Iron Fist, though Davos never conceded.
changes.evidence: The entry sums up their whole upbringing. The K'un-Lun flashback in S2 episode 2 (The City's Not for Burning) is the duel: Rand earns the right to the Iron Fist after Davos's father Lei Kung names him winner of a duel against Davos, though Davos had not conceded.

now: Marc and Steven wake on a boat in the afterlife with the goddess Taweret.
proposed: Taweret tells Marc and Steven they are dead and sailing through the Duat on her boat, and weighs their hearts on the Scales of Justice.
changes.evidence: Marc and Steven wake in the psychiatric hospital and meet the hippo-headed figure at the end of episode 4 (The Tomb). In episode 5 (Asylum) Taweret explains they are dead, that the hospital is a boat sailing through the Duat, and weighs their hearts.

now: Ka-Zar helps the powerless Xavier and Magneto, and the X-Men fight their way in to free them from Mister Sinister.
proposed: Wolverine and Ka-Zar break into Sinister's lair to free the captives, and Xavier wrecks the machine that stole their powers so the X-Men can defeat Mister Sinister.
changes.evidence: In Reunion Part II the X-Men arrive powerless and are captured; only Wolverine escapes, teams up with Ka-Zar, and they free the prisoners. Xavier destroys the lab equipment, restoring the powers of the X-Men and Magneto, and they defeat Sinister. Ka-Zar first rescues and helps Xavier and Magneto in Part I (#25), and the X-Men do not fight their way in.

now: Peter Parker takes on the Kingpin while his powers start to change him.
proposed: With his powers failing, Spider-Man walks into the Insidious Six's trap and is unmasked, and Connors tells him his mutation is the cause.
changes.evidence: The entry sums up the season's arc. In #15 (Battle of the Insidious Six) Spider-Man walks into the Kingpin's Insidious Six trap at a warehouse, is captured and unmasked but convinces them he is a fraud, and Connors reveals he is mutating further, which is why his powers briefly vanish.
